name: Persistent assigned anchor-relative fields in native shared SAGE acquisition
observation_to_explain: Competence deficits and strict common-rival errors may require information that native local processing does not expose usefully. P-GNN establishes a possible local/global-position distinction; no actual missing-position diagnosis is asserted for WikiCS.
substantially_different_from_closed_cont: Adds label-free graph positional measurements before native learned propagation under ordinary own CE. It changes input information; it is not another within-class loss, an independent teacher/distillation stage, a learned feature-neighbor kernel, a motif split or a full private backbone.

one_fixed_operation.graph: Full existing11701-node public graph. Distance support = simple undirected union of factual nonself edges; the original native propagation edge_index is preserved. Anchors use public topology/node IDs only, no TRAIN/VALID/TEST labels.
one_fixed_operation.anchors: One label-independent seed9100043 fixes128 nonempty anchor sets:4banks ×4scales ×8replicates. Inclusion probabilities per scale are1/8,1/64,1/512,1/4096. Redraw only empty sets. Ordering is bank,scale,replicate; retain anchors and hashes. This is a finite practical choice, not the full Bourgain log-squared construction or a tuning grid.
one_fixed_operation.field: D[v,k]=1/(1+distance(v,S_k));0 for unreachable; exact unweighted multi-source BFS on the full declared support. Cache all128 fields once, without stochastic resampling during fits or serving.
one_fixed_operation.route_assignment: Route m retains every original X feature and its native graph, but receives only its32 assigned anchor coordinates. Implement prospectively as a fixed diagonal mask over the same complete128-column field bank. All arms have the same300+128 stem input shape and added128×128 slow stem weight coordinates; all-evidence arms expose all fields. No implementation is supplied.
one_fixed_operation.stem_and_initialization: The new shared stem columns start at zero; every original300-column native parameter, existing fast factor and RNG stream is copied from an ordinary fresh300-feature baseline construction before adding metadata. Extend first input Rademacher factors with a separate deterministic generator; preserve original entries and other native starts. Thus the deterministic initial factual predictions equal baseline. This is an initializer construction, not a trained teacher or competence guarantee.
one_fixed_operation.learning_serving: Same native depth2/width128/LayerNorm/dropout.2, complete own-member TRAIN CE and existing AdamW.001/decay0/horizon1000/patience300, paired seeds7301/7403/7507 and strict native selector. No auxiliary loss. Probability-mean serving from the full factual graph and fixed anchor fields; no learned gate, additional served graph pass, class-specific routing or label input.

strongest_prior.P_GNN: 1906.04817v1 §§4.1–4.3 already computes many anchor-conditioned coordinates using trainable shared aggregation, explicitly couples anchor identities across nodes, and changes local information into global position. Fixed anchors are an adaptation of its resampled anchors, not a new positional principle.
strongest_prior.SubGNN: 2006.10538v1 §§3–4 already defines independent position/neighborhood/structure routing channels, graph-wide shared border-position anchors, similarity-weighted anchor messages and fused outputs. This is direct multi-anchor/multibranch ancestry, with subgraph versus node/task and prediction-bank scope differences.
strongest_prior.ensemble_assignment: Saved GNN-Ensemble random subfeatures and sampled substructures are direct persistent input-bagging ancestry; native private fast factors/shared dense maps are existing BatchEnsemble ancestry. A shared trunk plus fixed assigned positional fields does not clear extension novelty.

decisive_controls.all_anchor_information_and_capacity: All128 fields in the identical augmented shared4 model, ordinary M1, factorized M1 and genuine independent I4. Same native schedules/data/steps/seeds/selectors and original starts; each body gets all fields. These are capable same-information references, not historical nonequipped scores.
decisive_controls.sharing: Genuine factorized I4 with the same four assigned32-field masks and independent bodies. This separates sharing from assigned positional acquisition while retaining native independent own selection.
decisive_controls.factual_position: Assigned shared4 with one fixed label-free joint row permutation of the full128-field bank within predeclared floor(log2(1+undirected_degree)) buckets, seed9100051, while keeping factual X and propagation edges. All four banks use the same permutation so cross-bank field-row dependence is preserved. It tests factual node/anchor incidence, not a unique global-distance causal effect.
decisive_controls.anchors: Unchanged native shared, capable ordinary/factorized M1 and genuine I4, reused only under verified exact custody.
decisive_controls.interpretation_limit: Assigned vs all-anchor shared compares the complete allocation procedure, including input exposure, parameter-column duty cycle and gradient statistics. It cannot isolate a particular gradient-interference or position mechanism. Candidate beating all-anchor capable references would support a constrained acquisition bias; all-anchor matching it implies a backbone/input gain rather than evidence for private allocation.

prediction_and_refutation: The assigned field bank should improve complete served quality and mean/worst-member competence over unchanged shared, and supply net correctly served repairs on a frozen strict common-rival cohort beyond same-information capable references. A strict common rival can be overcome only when learned predictions reverse sufficient true-class/rival margin; extra distances themselves do not guarantee this. No full quality benefit, competence/NLL harm, harms outweighing repairs, or matched all-anchor/shuffled references accounting for the result refutes the intended utility or allocation claim. Representation distance and field coverage are not success criteria.
risks: Fixed anchor coordinates can be nuisances or overfit580 labels in one transductive graph
Different anchor identities across routes can make common weights fit incompatible coordinate conventions
Rare components can have mostly unreachable/zero fields
Disjoint masks introduce functionally private stem-column credit; causal allocation interpretation is limited
Original features can already encode useful positions, making new fields redundant
Useful correct alternatives can still be lost by probability averaging
compute: COMPUTE_EXPECTATION.json; full prospective seven-arm/three-seed roster is21newbanks/39nativefits before any original-anchor/calibration processing. Root can reject or prospectively reduce the scientific question before source creation; no partial result chooses a subset.
quality_rule_authority: Root sets margins, complete-family eligibility and equal calibration before any source/fit; this packet supplies no tuned numeric gate. Positive encountered-development evidence would require unused confirmation before a paper claim.
current_source_and_weighted_hypothesis: Remain unchanged/inactive. Complete context-negative disposition is preserved; it does not decide this changed-input hypothesis. No current outcome files opened.
